title: Polynomial expansion over low-degree subsets
statement: Let $n,d$ be natural numbers, let $z$ assign an integer to each subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of size at most $d$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Form a multilinear polynomial whose coefficient on each subset is the corresponding value of $z$ when that subset has size at most $d$, and is zero otherwise. Its value at $x$ equals the sum, over all subsets of size at most $d$, of the corresponding integer coefficient (viewed as real) times the sign monomial on that subset.
hypotheses_covered: Integer-valued coefficient function z on the family of subsets of Fin n of size at most d
